CategoryRead.title: CategoryRead
CategoryRead.description: A whole-number column read as categories (R-CMP-01).

Choices.title: Choices
Choices.description: Everything the preparation editor can change. The defaults are the automatic rules.

ClassCurves.title: ClassCurves
ClassCurves.description: One class against all the others (multiclass): its ROC, precision-recall and calibration.

Classes.title: Classes
Classes.description: How the numeric target is cut: k - 1 inner limits, k names, intervals (a, b].

ColumnChange.title: ColumnChange
ColumnChange.description: A correction of one column. `None` fields are left unchanged.

ColumnChoice.title: ColumnChoice
ColumnChoice.description: What the user set for one column; None = automatic.

ComputeSettings.title: ComputeSettings
ComputeSettings.description: None = automatic: on when a ready GPU is found. Used by the deep models (023b).

DetectionSettings.title: DetectionSettings
DetectionSettings.description: Bounds keep detection sensible: below half, "mostly numbers" would mean nothing.

Fitted.title: Fitted
Fitted.description: What the method found, shown with the run.

GroupLayout.title: GroupLayout
GroupLayout.description: How a number and one or two categories were laid out (R-CMP-04, R-CMP-05).

LearningCurve.title: LearningCurve
LearningCurve.description: How the model improved iteration after iteration (iterative models only).

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: A dataset created from a synthetic run.

Parser.title: Parser
Parser.description:
How to read a stored value in its analysis type, applied at query time.

- raw: the stored value as is
- number: text with a given decimal separator (thousands separators, %, currency stripped)
- date: text with a strptime format
- boolean: text mapped with true/false vocabularies (empty lists: cast the value)
- year: integer year → date (January 1st)
- text: the value as text, null tokens removed

smooth_reason.title: Smooth Reason
smooth_reason.default: On: continuous numbers stay off the real values, so far fewer rows copy a real one.

PreparationPreview.title: PreparationPreview
PreparationPreview.description: The matrix the model really receives: the first training rows once prepared.

QQ.title: QQ
QQ.description: Sample quantiles against the standard normal's, with the line through Q1 and Q3.

Run.title: Run
Run.description: A trained model as the page shows it (stored as JSON next to the fitted pipeline).

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: Everything not given takes the plan's automatic choice.

SearchParam.title: SearchParam
SearchParam.description: One setting of the search space, as the user may change it.

SequenceRequest.title: SequenceRequest
SequenceRequest.description: TimeGAN: every field not given takes the plan's choice.

SeriesSetup.title: SeriesSetup
SeriesSetup.description: The configuration actually used: every field chosen or defaulted.

SourceOptions.title: SourceOptions
SourceOptions.description: How to read a source. `None` fields mean "detect" or "everything".

TargetDistribution.title: TargetDistribution
TargetDistribution.description:
What the browser needs to cut the target: exact quantiles, a fine histogram, a sorted
sample (natural breaks) and, for few distinct values, each value with its count.

TimeView.title: TimeView
TimeView.description: How a date and a number was turned into a series (each setting chosen or defaulted).

Validation.title: Validation
Validation.description: How the model is judged, and on how many rows it is trained.
